messages.author: d6a22ac7ce11aa1b
messages.subject: Looping within different rows
parts:
Hi All,

I recently started working on R software, and I am facing difficulties automating the attached process. j range between 1:40,000. I need j to change from 1 through 40,000 and save the results in the same excel file,see the colored line. Any help will be appreciated.

Thank you.


j<-pred_totalcrashes[11, ]
j
########################################################################################################################
# computing average crashes CB
CB_lowerQ_1<-j[1:79]
CB_lowerQ_1
CB_lowerQ_2<-j[80:158]
CB_lowerQ_2
CB_lowerQ_3<-j[159:237]
CB_lowerQ_3

# computing average crashes CA
CA_lowerQ_1<-j[238:316]
CA_lowerQ_1
CA_lowerQ_2<-j[317:395]
CA_lowerQ_2
CA_lowerQ_3<-j[396:474]
CA_lowerQ_3

# COMPARISON RATIO
comparison_ratio_1<-CA_lowerQ_1/CB_lowerQ_1 
comparison_ratio_2<-CA_lowerQ_2/CB_lowerQ_2 
comparison_ratio_3<-CA_lowerQ_3/CB_lowerQ_3

# computing average crashes TB
TB_lowerQ_1<-j[475:553]
TB_lowerQ_1
TB_lowerQ_2<-j[554:632]
TB_lowerQ_2
TB_lowerQ_3<-j[633:711]
TB_lowerQ_3

# PREDICTED TA CRASHES
TA_lowerQ_absent_1<-comparison_ratio_1*TB_lowerQ_1
TA_lowerQ_absent_2<-comparison_ratio_2*TB_lowerQ_2
TA_lowerQ_absent_3<-comparison_ratio_3*TB_lowerQ_3
TA_lowerQ_absent<- (TA_lowerQ_absent_1+TA_lowerQ_absent_2+TA_lowerQ_absent_3)/3
TA_lowerQ_absent

# computing average crashes TA
TA_lowerQ_1<-j[712:790]
TA_lowerQ_1
TA_lowerQ_2<-j[791:869]
TA_lowerQ_2
TA_lowerQ_3<-j[870:948]
TA_lowerQ_3
TA_lowerQ_site<-(TA_lowerQ_1+TA_lowerQ_2+TA_lowerQ_3)/3
TA_lowerQ_site

### computing index of effectiveness
# lower quartile (2.5%)
effectiveness_lowerQ_index_1<-TA_lowerQ_1/TA_lowerQ_absent_1
effectiveness_lowerQ_index_1
effectiveness_lowerQ_index_2<-TA_lowerQ_2/TA_lowerQ_absent_2
effectiveness_lowerQ_index_2
effectiveness_lowerQ_index_3<-TA_lowerQ_3/TA_lowerQ_absent_3
effectiveness_lowerQ_index_3
effectiveness_lowerQ_index<-(effectiveness_lowerQ_index_1+effectiveness_lowerQ_index_2+effectiveness_lowerQ_index_3)/3

# removing inf data
CMF<-data.frame(effectiveness_lowerQ_index)
CMF
is.na(CMF)<-sapply(CMF, is.infinite)
CMF
write.csv(CMF, file = "CMF_11.csv")
